subject: Handoff: LumaTech Health — Activation housekeeping and committed deliverables
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sophie Reed <sophie.reed@lumatechhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@lumatechhealth.com>, Lumatech Procurement <contracts@lumatechhealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Handoff: LumaTech Health — Activation housekeeping and committed deliverables

Team — quick handoff for LumaTech (contract signed yesterday). High-level context and asks below; please read once and flag anything that looks off. I’ve attached the latest SOW (v2) with the minor pricing/term edits the customer negotiated.

Deal summary (short):
- ARR: $180k first year (12-month term)
- Committed rollout start: 2028-05-22 (production API calls expected by 2028-06-05)
- Primary integration: ingest via customer S3 -> our private endpoint; optional streaming later

Primary goals for this handoff:
1) Confirm owners for kickoff and 30/60-day success commitments (I’m proposing Mina as CS lead, Vanessa as Impl lead, Karthik as Tech PM).
2) Agree kickoff date/time (week of 5/8) and agenda.
3) Identify immediate blockers (data sample access, credentials, SOC2 evidence).
4) Accept the attached SOW-v2 and note items the customer expects during onboarding (see bullets below).

Key customer asks from sales discovery:
- Delivery of a production-facing ingestion pipeline with per-tenant routing (customer will provide S3 buckets).
- Data retention policy confirmation (30/90/365 days options) — legal asked for specifics.
- Initial training for two product owners + ops runbook handoff.

Known risks/notes:
- Customer uses a bespoke ETL that will drop enriched metadata fields; we should validate schema mapping early.
- SOC2 attestation in progress; they asked for log retention and access controls — Vivek, please note for the security checklist.
- Procurement wants a 30-day completion milestone tied into final payment; finance has approved milestone-based schedule in the SOW.

Suggested immediate next steps:
- Mina: confirm CS kickoff owner and propose two times (45m) next week for intake.
- Vanessa & Karthik: review integration checklist in the Drive link I’ll share and flag any capacity/tech constraints.
- Connor (me): I’ll upload the signed SOW, HubSpot deal ID, and DocuSign envelope link.

Attachments: SOW-LumaTech-v2.pdf, integration-checklist.xlsx, sample-payloads.json

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Reed <sophie.reed@lumatechhealth.com>, Tom Park <tom.park@lumatechhealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: LumaTech Health — Activation housekeeping and committed deliverables

Thanks, Connor — noted and congrats on the close. Quick confirmations from CS side:
- I can take point as CS lead for the 30/60-day milestones; I’ll be the primary post-sign contact for feature enablement and acceptance.
- Proposed kickoff windows: Tue 2028-05-09 at 10:00 PT or Wed 2028-05-10 at 14:00 PT (45m). Sophie/Tom — do either work for you?

A few asks from CS to the team:
- Vanessa/Karthik: can you confirm that the integration-checklist includes a row for schema drift monitoring (customer has variable payloads)? If not, add as a requirement.
- Vivek: procurement will likely ask about our audit log retention and KMS approach — the customer expects configuration details in the first week.
- Connor: please share the HubSpot link + DocuSign id; I want them pinned to the kickoff calendar invite.

I’ll draft a short intake doc (one pager) after kickoff to capture acceptance criteria and owners.

Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0224

Mina — thanks. Adding a couple of operational items and links inline:

- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/4721 (permissions set, will add Mina/Vanessa).
- DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelopes/ABC12345 — final signature completed yesterday.
- Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/LumaTech/onboarding/ (contains SOW-v2, integration-checklist, and sample payloads)

Per your ask, I attached SOW-LumaTech-v2.pdf (final), integration-checklist.xlsx (ticked the high-risk items), and sample-payloads.json (small sanitized dump the customer provided). I also highlighted two items for implementation:
  1) "tenant-routing" requires a small change to our ingestion lambda (2-3 hrs dev + 1 hr validation).
  2) They will request KMS key scoping language in our standard security addendum; Vivek, can you prepare a short blurb we can send to their security contact pre-kickoff?

On procurement: contracts@lumatechhealth.com asked if we can accept the milestone schedule tied to the final 30-day acceptance. Finance has pre-approved but we should capture the milestone acceptance criteria in the intake doc.

Let me know if you want me to set the kickoff calendar with the two windows Mina proposed.

Connor
